recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black and white studio portrait of a seated man looking downward, framed by a large, thin geometric sans-serif title at the top edge. The lighting is bright and even, creating a high-key background that isolates the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically and horizontally against a stark white void
Typography spanning the full width of the upper margin
Downward gaze of the subject creating a sense of introspection or humility
High-contrast textures in clothing (denim, stripes) against smooth skin and background
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color profile

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium shot, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's head and baseball cap, positioned just below the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the wide title at the top, moves down to the subject's face, follows the arms down to the clasped hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subject, particularly in the upper corners and sides.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys in fabric textures and skin
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from absolute white to absolute black.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform line thickness throughout all characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is stylized as a simple, thin-line loop or 'plus' variant to match the geometric weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for maximum minimalist impact.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment along the top edge

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or Extra Bold (tracked out)
ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Extreme geometric purity and circular forms

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a man with a beard wearing a baseball cap and a striped shirt, seated and looking down at his clasped hands. The background must be pure, blown-out white with no visible horizon line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a single line of text in the top margin using a thin-weight geometric sans-serif font in all caps. Use wide tracking so the text spans nearly the full width of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly centered and thin?
Is the background pure white without distracting elements?

mustRedesign: Any specific logos on the clothing
The specific facial identity of the subject
The exact wording of the title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not touch the subject's head.
Ensure the black levels in the subject's clothing are deep and rich.
Verify the ampersand matches the stroke weight of the letters.
Confirm the image is centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key monochrome portrait + Thin Geometric Sans-Serif Header = Introspective Modern Minimalist Aesthetic
